mechanism: Bumetanide causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia, which increase digoxin toxicity risk by enhancing cardiac binding and reducing renal clearance.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels closely; maintain potassium >3.5 mEq/L and magnesium >2.0 mg/dL; consider potassium-sparing agent or supplementation; monitor digoxin levels and cardiac rhythm.
